# HighJump

**Category:** Movement  
**Aliases:** High Jump, HighJump

## What it does

HighJump lets you leap higher than the normal Minecraft jump, boosting your upward launch the moment you press jump. It's handy for reaching ledges, scaling walls, or clearing obstacles that a standard jump can't get you over.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/movement/highjump). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
